note: Settles the FFN question ON THE WINNING CONFIG. ReLU^2 alone was a TIE (iso-token +0.032, iso-compute -0.003), measured on the old baseline before gated attention and untied embeddings existed. Two reasons to retest on the stack: throughput is the dominant axis and ReLU^2's +2.9% is worth more now, and the gate changes what the FFN has to do so the interaction is not predictable. Also matters beyond a4.5 -- 2-matrix ReLU^2 experts are what make Nemotron's 128-expert MoE affordable, so this reading feeds the 5.0 design. inter 6192 -> 9280 keeps it iso-param with the gated stack (2 matrices at 1.5x width).
